title: Tailwind
description: An iPhone drive logbook. It records drives automatically (route, speed, corners, elevation), scores each one out of 100, and keeps them in a logbook with records, medals and a garage of cars. Runs on the Lock Screen, in CarPlay, on Apple Watch and in widgets.

title: Regimen
description: An iOS skincare app that orders your routine, flags ingredient conflicts between products, and predicts when you'll run out. Progress photos are scored on-device with a Core ML model, giving a 0–100 score and per-zone results tracked over time.

title: Skin Cancer Detection Model
description: A convolutional neural network trained on 10,000+ dermoscopic images across 7 classes of skin lesions, reaching 89% classification accuracy. There's a live demo below.

title: Charity Donation App
description: An iOS donation app with a SwiftUI profile experience built from reusable components, backed by AWS Lambda and EC2 for backend logic and file storage.

title: Attendance Tracker
description: An attendance system with a Java REST API behind a React dashboard, plus a companion iOS app that checks students in with barcode scanning and Face ID.

title: This Portfolio
description: This site. Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no framework or build step. Content is loaded from JSON files, and the demos below are written from scratch.
